text:
ema: heads-up — deploybot auto-sticky-pinned runtime-4.1 for the 'rerank-plus' family after abrupt kernel restarts. need a short plan for a split unpin during the 02:00 maintenance window.
deploybot: [automated] sticky pin applied. pin_id=pb-2025-07-01-08. Affected: model-group 'rerank-plus' (rerank-v3, rerank-lite). Trigger: kernel_restart_rate > 2% (5m). details: https://redwood.internal/pins/pb-2025-07-01-08

noah: quick scan — failures spike on long context + batched rerank jobs. interactive low-latency routes seem fine.

viv: proposal: split unpin by route type and seq length: canary on non-dedicated interactive routes max_seq<=4096, exclude dedicated and batch pipelines. If canary passes, expand to short-batch (<=8192) then full.

ranjit: agree with staged approach. also request header tagging for canary traffic (`X-Pin-Canary:pb-2025-07-01-08`) so logs are easy to filter.

ops-sre-bot: runbook snippet: `deploybot unpin --pin pb-2025-07-01-08 --scope region:eu-west --traffic-filter "max_seq<=4096 AND route:!=dedicated AND route:!=batch" --request-headers "X-Pin-Canary:pb-2025-07-01-08" --mode canary`. monitor: `kernel_restart_rate`, `oom_rate`, `p95_latency`, `error_rate`.

ema: rollback criteria: if kernel_restart_rate >0.5% OR oom_rate >0.4% OR p95_latency increases >10% within 15m -> immediate re-pin to runtime-4.1 or route to runtime-4.0 for affected routes.

noah: i'll prepare a tiny synthetic harness to exercise canary hosts and check deterministic outputs. will tag runs with the header.

viv: schedule: canary start 02:00 UTC -> monitor 15m -> decision at 02:20 -> if green expand to short-batch 02:45 -> full unwind target 04:00. fallback plan documented.

ops-sre-bot: ops checklist: 1) tag canary hosts `pin_canary=pb-2025-07-01-08` 2) run canary unpin command at 02:00 UTC 3) run synthetic harness and watch metrics 4) decision point at +20m 5) rollback command: `deploybot pin --pin pb-2025-07-01-08 --force`

ranjit: i'll add ephemeral dashboards and alert `pin_unpin_rollback_needed` if kernel_restart_rate jumps after unpin.

ema: release notes blurb: "Temporary sticky pin pb-2025-07-01-08 on runtime-4.1 for rerank-plus due to kernel restarts on long/batch jobs. Scoped canary unpin planned; dedicated and batch routes excluded." viv please add to release tracker and notify CS.

viv: done, patched release tracker and will DM CS for top customers.

noah: synthetic smoke (short): `for i in {1..500}; do curl -s -H "X-Pin-Canary: pb-2025-07-01-08" "https://canary/api/generate?model=rerank-lite&max_seq=1024" > r.$i.json & done; wait; jq -s '[.[]] | {errors: map(select(.status!=200))|length, p95:(map(.latency)|sort)[int(length*0.95)]}' r.*.json`

ema: ok all — react with :eyes: to let deploybot schedule the canary. will hold the channel for canary results.

deploybot: awaiting reactions to schedule.

ops-sre-bot: tagged oncall: primary @viv, secondary @noah.

viv: i'll be on for the window and will post results.

ema: thanks team. keep logs in the incident tracker and reopen thread with results
_meta: generated by dataset-gen: split unpin + header-tagged canary for sticky runtime pin
